block corners north of Dreman visible at the top edge; Borden water pipe continues north
block north of Dreman spans Dawson; Dawson west face is the east line of the triangular lot 3653 beside the railroad
block corners east of Roll at the right edge; Ralston continues onto sheet 608

end of the curve; straight SW at about 46 deg from here to the left edge (leaves the sheet at about x 68, y 7004)

notes: North is up. Streets are printed DREMAN (no suffix, recorded as Dreman Street), LLEWELLYN AV., BORDEN (no suffix here, on sheet 609 or on the key map; recorded as Borden Street), DAWSON AV., ROLL AV., RALSTON AV. Ralston is marked (NOT OPEN) between the C.H.&D. R.R. and Dawson. Dawson continues to the bottom edge; where the creek crosses it it is marked STREET NOT OPEN HERE. Roll also runs to the bottom edge. Llewellyn crosses the creek on a bridge at y~2950. Llewellyn is recorded as 'Llewellyn Avenue (south of Dreman)' because on sheet 609 the Llewellyn north of Dreman is a separate dead-end piece that does not reach Dreman. The N-S streets lean slightly (Llewellyn and Borden centres move ~35 px west between Dreman and Ralston; Dawson and Roll less). Dreman centre drifts from y~197 at Llewellyn to ~277 at Roll (north face at the page edge on the west part). Ignore the city limits line and the railroad.
